blocks.md: **DP = recursion + never-recompute. Memoize (top-down) or tabulate (bottom-up) - same math, different direction.**

blocks.title: Trace: naive fib(5) recomputed nodes vs memo hits

blocks.label: memo fix in three lines
blocks.py:
memo = [-1] * 100
def fib(n):
    if n <= 1: return n                  # base
    if memo[n] != -1: return memo[n]     # NOTEBOOK CHECK
    memo[n] = fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)        # compute ONCE, store
    return memo[n]

blocks.label: same problem bottom-up (tabulation)
blocks.py:
dp = [1] * (n + 1)                    # dp[i] = ways to reach stair i
for i in range(1, n+1):
    dp[i] = dp[i-1]
    if i >= 2: dp[i] += dp[i-2]
answer = dp[n]
